title: Test human-in-the-loop: interview workflow
description: Run `fabro run interview --environment default --model glm-4.7` and exercise the interview dock: yes/no, confirmation, multiple_choice, multi_select, freeform. Answer via CLI and once via the web UI interview dock on the same run. Verify progressive questions and the final summary stage.

title: Test steering and interrupts: sleeper workflow
description: Start `fabro run sleeper --environment default --model glm-4.7` (runs ~5 min). While active: (1) `fabro steer <run-id> --message '...'` mid-execution, (2) pause/interrupt from the web UI, (3) resume, (4) afterwards `fabro rewind` and `fabro fork` on the finished run to exercise checkpoint features.

title: Test end-to-end codegen agent: solitaire-fast
description: Run `fabro run solitaire-fast --environment default --model glm-5.2` — a real codegen agent building a terminal Klondike solitaire in Python inside the docker sandbox. Verify: sandbox clone, multi-stage graph execution, artifact inspection (`fabro artifact`), and the resulting game file in the run output.

title: Set up toolchain environment and test smoke workflow
description: The default docker env (buildpack-deps:noble) lacks rustc/bun, so smoke and goal workflows fail at the toolchain stage. Create a server-managed environment via web UI (Settings -> Environments) or API using the toolchain Dockerfile from .fabro/Dockerfile (rustup + pinned nightly-2026-04-14 + cargo-nextest + bun). Then run `fabro run smoke --environment <new-env>` to verify full lint/test pipeline in the sandbox. Heavy: expect Rust compile load (see docs/internal/self-host-resource-planning.md).
